full_prompt:
Draw exactly ONE Small Seal glyph U+3D067.
The supplied chart shows FOUR historical views of the SAME ONE Small Seal character, ordered THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC. Compare EVERY available witness equally; any slot marked unavailable provides no evidence. Create ONE newly drawn, coherent contemporary sans-serif/Gothic glyph informed by all witnesses, selecting ONE coherent attested construction where variants differ. Never combine incompatible components or replace this with modern Chinese. Trace the real continuous writing-stroke courses using smooth rounded curves and appropriate straight segments; preserve all meaningful branches, legs, bars, counters, crossings, attachments and detachments. Each intentional stroke has the SAME CONSTANT width, approximately 3% of the full canvas, with rounded caps and joins. No brush taper, thick/thin pressure, serifs, texture, ink blobs, doubled outlines or ornamental seal effects. Output exactly ONE complete glyph, black on transparent alpha, centered within the central70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. No reference copies, four-character layout, labels, text, frames, grid, backdrop or shadows.
STRUCTURAL AND PROPORTIONAL READING:
1. All FOUR witnesses available. Entire glyph is ONE branched main stem plus THREE small lower-left detached horizontal bars; no ritual radical.
2. Main stem starts high, with a short rightward hook above the large crossbar that curves upward at its free right end (coherent THX/DYC form). Preserve the upright top tip and the separate upward hook tip.
3. ONE broad horizontal crosses the stem around upper-third height; this is the WIDEST horizontal of the glyph. Below it, main stem bends smoothly right and descends as a long lower-right curved tail.
4. Exactly THREE detached short horizontal strokes are stacked beneath the broad crossbar, entirely to the LEFT of the lower-right tail, separated from it and from each other in coherent THX/DYC construction. Bottom of these three is longest; upper two shorter and near equal.
5. Keep the large crossbar attached to stem and upper hook attached above it. The three small bars remain detached; no fourth short bar or closed counter.
Compare all four available variants equally, then use a coherent attested THX/DYC-type upright-with-hook and detached lower bars, preserving the widest upper crossing bar and exactly three shorter detached bars below-left. No incompatible mix with CCZ joined lower teeth.
